fonts.display: 'Season Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
fonts.body: 'Season Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes, nav outlines — the near-black that carries 90% of all foreground weight. Not pure black: a warm brown-black that feels printed, not screened

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, nav-pill fill, button text on dark — a warm off-white with the faintest yellow-green cast that matches the sage and sand sections without competing

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Secondary text, subtle borders, muted metadata — a mid neutral that sits between Ink and the page; used when primary text would be too heavy

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Filled CTA buttons, active markers — slightly warmer than Ink; the button fill that reads as a dense matte stamp rather than a flat black

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Tertiary text, low-emphasis borders — for labels and helper text that should recede further than Ash

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Heading borders, de-emphasized dividers — the lightest neutral that still registers as a line on Bone

palette.name: Deep Earth
palette.role: Alternate surface for code-adjacent panels and inset blocks — a warm dark that bridges Ink and the mid neutrals

palette.name: Soft Sand
palette.role: Secondary section background, 1px sand-colored hairline dividers, striped-pattern accent — the warm neutral that lives between the chromatic sections and true gray

palette.name: Warm Stone
palette.role: Khaki section background, tonal counterpoint to Sage — the muted olive-khaki that fills body-text sections and grounds the palette's middle register

palette.name: Sage
palette.role: Hero section background, signature accent — a desaturated mint that signals freshness without being loud; the only color bold enough to hold a 120px headline

palette.name: Powder Blue
palette.role: Code-panel background, striped-pattern accent, 1px blue hairlines — the cool counterweight to all the warm earth tones; appears wherever monospace code or technical data lives
